notes.title: Shu's Garden 2.4 Is Out!
notes.content:
Shu's Garden 2.4 is now available, featuring:

Performance improvments.
Corrections to localisations.
New insect life!


Grab a couple controllers and come chill in the space-garden with Shu and her friends!
